Attribute the 1895 census product to INEGI and the Dirección General de Estadística; distinguish original historical content from INEGI's digitization.

methods.retrieval: Downloaded all three official INEGI PDF segments and recorded byte lengths and SHA-256 values; fetched the INEGI 1895 program record, catalogue page, and free-use terms PDF.
methods.inspection: Used pdfinfo and pdftotext to locate tables; visually reviewed the original title page and printed page 6. Transcribed two rows from the scan. OCR output was not accepted as a numeric authority.
methods.territorial_scope: The evaluated table is summarized by source-era States and has a national sum row. Its four named region headings are source organization labels. No municipalities, settlements, modern parent assignments, or historical footprints are inferred.
methods.uncertainty: The Aguascalientes row has an arithmetic discrepancy of 30 between sex columns and printed total. No correction is inferred. The reviewed page does not define usual-resident versus present-person universe, undercount, or uncertainty interval. The publication-year discrepancy between cover and running footer remains unresolved.
